news.q: What percent of Americans plan to celebrate Halloween this year, according to the National Retail Federation?
news.fact: They're expected to spend $13.5 billion in all, including $4.1 billion on candy.

news.q: On Oct. 27, the UN's weather agency said carbon dioxide in the air hit a record average in 2025. How many parts per million was it, to the nearest whole number?
news.fact: The 2025 average was 426.8 ppm, about 153% of pre-industrial levels.

easy.fact: The K-pop group's fans call themselves ARMY.

easy.q: How many Kardashian–Jenner sisters are there?
easy.fact: Kourtney, Kim, Khloé, Kendall and Kylie.

easy.q: How many justices sit on the U.S. Supreme Court?
easy.fact: It has had nine seats since 1869.

medium.fact: All of them walked there between 1969 and 1972.

hard.fact: Mount Everest would fit inside with more than a mile to spare.

hard.q: How many 3-pointers did Stephen Curry make in the 2015-16 season, the NBA record?
hard.fact: He was the NBA's first unanimous MVP that season.

hard.fact: He gave a nearly two-hour inaugural speech in the cold, and fell ill soon after.
